disclosureQuote: About 10% of this game’s art assets were created with AI-assisted design, including some combat scenes and talent icons. All AI-generated content was reviewed, adjusted, and polished by artists. The remaining art assets were hand-crafted.
summary: 克苏鲁题材放置 RPG。开发者披露约 10% 的美术资产由 AI 辅助设计（含部分战斗场面与天赋图标），产出经美术复核、调整与润色，其余美术资产为手绘。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Small Mill）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 280），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 5 次、登记 9 条去重结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（Steam 高分评测页，玩家在其中讨论商店页的 AI 披露）；未检索到针对本作的独立媒体报道，一个第三方数据面板页正文与 AI 披露无关，未采用。领域判定以商店披露原文为准，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露只涉及美术，且给出约 10% 的比例，其余领域未作说明。

english.summary: A Lovecraftian idle RPG. The developer states that about 10% of art assets were created with AI-assisted design, including some combat scenes and talent icons, that all AI-generated content was reviewed and polished by artists, and that the remaining art is hand-crafted.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Small Mill) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 280); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched five times with 9 deduplicated results logged and one raw source read (the top-rated Steam reviews page, where players discuss the store disclosure); no independent press article about this title was found and a third-party statistics page had no disclosure content, so it was not used. Area findings come from the store disclosure and rest on developer statements, not an independent audit.
